Roth.abs_eval_iterated_hasseDeriv_lt_aux✝.{u_1} {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ}
  {B α β : ℝ} {s : ℕ} (hP : ∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) (hB : 0 < B) (hs : ∑ j, r j ≤ s) (h2 : 2 ^ s < β)
  (hα : (1 + |α|) ^ s ≤ β) (hc : ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) (i k : σ →₀ ℕ) :
  |(eval fun x ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| < β * (β * B) * β

private theorem Roth.abs_eval_iterated_hasseDeriv_lt_aux.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ]
  {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ} {B α β : ℝ} {s : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    0 < B →
      ∑ j, r j ≤ s →
        2 ^ s < β →
          (1 + |α|) ^ s ≤ β →
            (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
              ∀ (i k : σ →₀ ℕ),
                |(eval fun x ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| < β * (β * B) * β :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {P} {r} {B α β} {s} hP hB hs h2 hα hc i k ↦
  have hdQ := fun j ↦ LE.le.trans (degreeOf_hasseDeriv_le j k P) (hP j);
  have heval :=
    Roth.abs_eval_le ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P))
      (fun j ↦ LE.le.trans (degreeOf_hasseDeriv_le j i ((hasseDeriv k) P)) (hdQ j))
      (Roth.abs_coeff_hasseDeriv_le i ((hasseDeriv k) P) hdQ (Roth.abs_coeff_hasseDeriv_le k P hP hc)) fun x ↦ α;
  have h2' :=
    LE.le.trans_lt
      (pow_le_pow_right₀
        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl true))
        hs)
      h2;
  LE.le.trans_lt
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg
        (fun _a ↦
          |(eval fun x ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| ≤
            (2 ^ ∑ j, r j) * ((2 ^ ∑ j, r j) * B) * _a)
        (Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum Finset.univ r (1 + |α|)))
      heval)
    (mul_lt_mul_of_nonneg_of_pos
      (mul_lt_mul'' h2' (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2' hB)
        (le_of_lt
          (pow_pos
            (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
              (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
            (∑ j, r j)))
        (le_of_lt
          (mul_pos
            (pow_pos
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
              (∑ j, r j))
            hB)))
      (LE.le.trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg α)) hs) hα)
      (le_of_lt
        (mul_pos
          (pow_pos
            (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
              (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
            (∑ j, r j))
          (mul_pos
            (pow_pos
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
              (∑ j, r j))
            hB)))
      (LT.lt.trans
        (pow_pos
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_lt_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl false))
          (∑ j, r j))
        h2'))

MAINLEMMA_PRIVATE255_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ} {B α β : ℝ}
  {s : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    0 < B →
      ∑ j : σ, r j ≤ s →
        2 ^ s < β →
          (1 + |α|) ^ s ≤ β →
            (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
              ∀ (i k : σ →₀ ℕ),
                |(eval fun (x : σ) ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| <
                  β * (β * B) * β
